principal.name: Prof. (Dr.) Sanjay L. Badjate
principal.responsibilities: Head of the institution, academic leadership, overall administration, statutory compliance, institutional development, and presiding Chairman of the Academic Council.

ceo.name: Mr. Sanjeev Agrawal
ceo.responsibilities: Strategic executive leadership, institutional expansion, corporate partnerships, resource planning, infrastructure management, and driving world-class benchmarks in technical education.

registrar.name: Registrar / Administration Office
registrar.responsibilities: Custodian of institute records, human resources, administrative governance, statutory reporting, university liaison, and student document verification.

controller_of_examinations.name: Prof. Pankaj Jaiswal
controller_of_examinations.responsibilities: Directing the autonomous examination system, paper setting, examination timetables, conduct of continuous assessment (CAT) and End Semester Examinations (ESE), evaluations, moderation, result declarations, and revaluation process.

dean_academics.name: Dr. Pankaj Thote
dean_academics.responsibilities: Academic planning, curriculum development, implementation of Outcome-Based Education (OBE), academic regulations, monitoring timetable and academic calendar execution, teaching-learning quality assurance.

dean_students_affairs.name: Dr. Yogesh P. Shinde
dean_students_affairs.responsibilities: Student welfare, disciplinary matters, student professional chapters, technical & cultural student clubs, NSS, NCC, sports coordination, student counseling, and hostel/transportation oversight.

dean_engineering.name: Dr. M. M. Raghuwanshi
dean_engineering.responsibilities: Overseeing technical and engineering faculties, interdisciplinary coordination, academic quality benchmarks across engineering departments, and teacher representation on the Academic Council.

dean_research_development.name: Dr. Raghvendra S. Dubey / Dr. Abhay Kasetwar
dean_research_development.responsibilities: Promoting sponsored research, patents, research publications, industrial consultancy, IPR cell, and research incentives for faculty and scholars.

head_training_and_placement.name: Mr. Ashish Lawrence
head_training_and_placement.responsibilities: Leading campus recruitment drives, industry-institute tie-ups, campus recruitment training (CRT), student internships, and corporate relations.
